column1: # The Rule growability golden fixture (spec §4 "Growability contract"; §8 for the presets), edited by hand under
# the contract. Its diff may only: add a rule with ALLOW in both presets when introducedIn is the current minor;
# flip a preset's ALLOW to REJECT when introducedIn is the previous minor and that preset's flippedIn is -, setting
# it; change exemptable from false to true; add a dataset's rows. Existing rules stay a subsequence of the rows'
# order, which is the precedence. RuleGoldenTest asserts the model equals it, and verifyRuleGrowability (#73)
